title: KestrelCare Cancellation Refund Worksheet
content:
The refund on a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts cancellation is worked from the plan record and from the holder's latest confirmed cancellation request on the plan, which gives the request date, the odometer on the request and the reason on the request.

## Part 1 — Full refund or pro rata

When the reason on the request is that the vehicle was returned under the 7-day return, or when the request date is within the plan's free-look days counted from the sale date and no claim has been paid on the plan, the refund is the full plan price; every other cancellation is settled pro rata.

- The free-look days count from the sale date as day 0; a request on the last free-look day is within them.
- "No claim has been paid" means the plan's history carries no claim payment.

## Part 2 — Pro rata settlement

A cancellation is settled pro rata on the plan price. The used share is the greater of two fractions: the calendar days from the plan's sale date to the cancellation request date over the calendar days from the sale date to the expiration date, and the miles from the odometer at sale to the odometer on the cancellation request over the plan's term miles. The refund is the plan price times one minus the used share, less the plan's cancellation fee, less the claim payments on the plan net of payments recovered when the plan deducts claims, rounded to the cent and never below zero.

| Line | Figure |
|---|---|
| a | time fraction: calendar days from sale date to request date, divided by calendar days from sale date to expiration date |
| b | miles fraction: odometer on the request less odometer at sale (not below zero), divided by the term miles |
| c | used share: the greater of a and b |
| d | plan price times one less c |
| e | less the plan's cancellation fee |
| f | less claim payments net of payments recovered, where the plan's coverage level deducts claims |
| g | refund: the result, never below zero, rounded to the cent at the end |

## Worked figures (hypothetical plan)

Plan price 2400.00; sale date 1 January 2025; expiration date 1 January 2028 (1095 calendar days); term miles 36000; odometer at sale 40000. Confirmed request dated 1 October 2025 (day 273, outside the free look) with 52000 miles, reason customer request; cancellation fee 50.00; the plan deducts claims, with claim payments of 300.00 and nothing recovered.

- a: 273 divided by 1095, about 0.2493
- b: 12000 divided by 36000, about 0.3333
- c: 0.3333 (miles)
- d: 2400.00 times two thirds gives 1600.00
- e, f: less 50.00 and less 300.00
- g: refund 1250.00

The same plan cancelled by a request dated 2 March 2025 (day 60) with no claim payment is refunded the full 2400.00.
